karen_sales: Heads-up: MegaBank wants a focused 2-week POC to validate our JS/Go SDK streaming model + function-calls, with strict structured JSON outputs for downstream parsers. They also listed SAML SSO, SCIM for service accounts, and short-term reserved capacity for onboarding spikes. Can we run a quick kickoff tomorrow?

liam_presales: Tomorrow lunchtime works. Quick Qs from their infra lead:
liam_presales: 1) Can we stream interim tokens and emit function-call lifecycle events so their UI can show progressive content?
liam_presales: 2) Can we pin an output schema per-route and enforce validation during the POC?
liam_presales: 3) For SAML/SCIM + KMS routing, any constraints for Dedicated vs Private?
liam_presales: 4) Pricing ask: 2-week reserved burst at ~2x baseline qps. What flexibility do we have?

amy_engineer: Streaming & function-calls: yes. Our SDKs support chunked token streaming plus explicit events for function_call start/end/result. Example SSE frames below:

amy_engineer: ```
data: {"evt":"token","text":"Good"}

data: {"evt":"function_call","name":"getAccount","status":"start","id":"fc_01"}

data: {"evt":"function_call","name":"getAccount","status":"end","id":"fc_01","result":{"balance":1234}}
```

amy_engineer: For structured outputs we have a `strict_schema` flag on routes that will reject non-conforming outputs and surface errors in the stream.

vijay_integration: Schema stability: recommend we provide a versioned JSON schema file and a fixtures bundle. We can host a sample repo they can `git clone` and run parser tests locally. For POC I'd suggest using `quantized-dev` runtime to keep token latency tight and predictable.

sara_security: SSO/SCIM/KMS: Private supports SAML SSO and KMS/HSM. Dedicated supports SAML but SCIM for service accounts is possible via a small sync lambda we run in their VPC; timeline ~2-4 business days depending on IdP. Audit logs can be forwarded to their SIEM (Splunk/Datadog).

deploy-bot: [infra] Temporary dedicated pool request queued by liam_presales: pool-xtmp-221. Provision ETA ~3h after approval.

liam_presales: I'll approve the pool and ask finance for a provisional quote.

amy_engineer: Client-side backpressure notes for streaming: keepalive every 30s, exponential reconnect with jitter, and pause/resume when client buffer exceeds threshold. Sample code for Node below.

amy_engineer: ```js
const s = client.stream(...);
s.on('data', d => { render(d.text); if (outstanding > 512) s.pause(); });
// resume logic when drained
```

vijay_integration: Proposed POC schedule:
1) Day 0: provision pool, issue scoped tokens.
2) Day 1: SDK quickstart + wire up schema/fixtures.
3) Day 2-3: streaming + function-call e2e and parser validation.
4) Day 4-7: reserved-burst scale tests and latency/cost capture.
5) Handover with runbooks for SSO/SCIM/KMS and ops.

karen_sales: Action items: liam confirm pricing, amy drop sample SSE & Node backpressure snippet, vijay prepare schema + fixtures repo, sara to review security form and flag blockers.

liam_presales: I'll post a provisional price today EOD and CC finance.

amy_engineer: Dropping a short Node backpressure snippet and example SSE frames to the thread now.

sara_security: Quick Q: are function_call payloads redacted in default logs? We need to answer this for the questionnaire.

amy_engineer: By default PII is redacted in hosted logs. For Private you can choose to retain full payloads if you have KMS and audit controls in place. We'll capture this in the runbook.

karen_sales: Locking tomorrow 12:30pm PT for kickoff unless someone objects.

liam_presales: 12:30pm PT works for me.

deploy-bot: [ticket] Security questionnaire attached to #sales:ticket: 4980 by sara_security.

vijay_integration: I'll upload the schema zip and a tiny fixture suite before EOD.

karen_sales: Thanks team, let's aim to have the POC runbook and provisional pricing in the thread before the call. :rocket:
